verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure intact: the quote and its attribution are grouped, the logo is bottom-left and the bottle bottom-right. Its flaws are a large empty band above the quote mark and an oversized, mostly empty maroon circle in the lower half. B breaks proximity by pulling 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' away from the quote into a cramped four-line stack inside the right circle. It also drops the logo awkwardly in the middle under the quote, which clutters the reading order, and leaves the bottle and circle crowded at the bottom-left beside dead space on the right.
